entries.title: Philippians 1:1
segments: Paul and Timothy, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and deacons.

entries.title: Philippians 1:2
segments: Grace to you, and peace from God our Father and from [the] Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Philippians 1:3
segments: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

entries.title: Philippians 1:4
segments: always in every prayer of mine making [my] request for you all with joy

entries.title: Philippians 1:5
segments: for your fellowship in the gospel from [the] first day until now;

entries.title: Philippians 1:6
segments: being confident of this very thing, that He who has begun a good work in you will perform [it] until the day of Jesus Christ,

entries.title: Philippians 1:7
segments: even as it is righteous for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart, inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partakers of my grace.

entries.title: Philippians 1:8
segments: For God is my witness how greatly I long after you all in [the] bowels of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Philippians 1:9
segments: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in full knowledge and [in] all perception;

entries.title: Philippians 1:10
segments: that you may distinguish [between] things that differ, that you may be sincere and without offense until the day of Jesus Christ,

entries.title: Philippians 1:11
segments: being filled [with the] fruits of righteousness through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

entries.title: Philippians 1:12
segments: But I desire that you should understand, brothers, that the things [which happened] to me have fallen out rather to [the] furtherance of the gospel;

entries.title: Philippians 1:13
segments: so that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other [places].

entries.title: Philippians 1:14
segments: And most of the brothers in [the] Lord, becoming confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

entries.title: Philippians 1:15
segments: Some indeed even preach Christ because of envy and strife, and some also of good will.

entries.title: Philippians 1:16
segments: Those, indeed, preach Christ out of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds.

entries.title: Philippians 1:17
segments: But these [others] preach in love, knowing that I am set for the defense of the gospel.

entries.title: Philippians 1:18
segments: What then? Nevertheless, in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is preached. And I rejoice in this. Yet, also I will rejoice.

entries.title: Philippians 1:19
segments: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer and [the] supply of [the] Spirit of Jesus Christ,

entries.title: Philippians 1:20
segments: according to my earnest expectation and hope that I shall be ashamed in nothing, but as always now Christ shall be magnified in my body with all boldness, whether it is by life or by death.

entries.title: Philippians 1:21
segments: For to me to live [is] Christ, and to die [is] gain.

entries.title: Philippians 1:22
segments: But if [I] live in [the] flesh, this [is] the fruit of [my] labor. Yet I do not know what I shall choose.

entries.title: Philippians 1:23
segments: For I am pressed together by the two: having a desire to depart and to be with Christ, which is far better.

entries.title: Philippians 1:24
segments: But to remain in the flesh [is] more needful for you.

entries.title: Philippians 1:25
segments: And having this confidence, I know that I shall remain and continue with you all, for your advancement and joy of faith,

entries.title: Philippians 1:26
segments: so that your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

entries.title: Philippians 1:27
segments: Only let your conduct be as becomes the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you, or else am absent, I may hear of your [affairs], that you stand fast in one spirit, striving together with one mind for the faith of the gospel,

entries.title: Philippians 1:28
segments: and terrified in nothing by your adversaries. [For this is] to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

entries.title: Philippians 1:29
segments: For to you it is given on behalf of Christ not only to believe on Him, but also to suffer for His sake,

entries.title: Philippians 1:30
segments: having the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear [to be] in me.
